builds.howItPlays: You spend the early turns gaining extra runes with Mobilize, a 2-cost spell that gives you one more rune, and Herald of Scales, a unit that makes your Dragons cost 2 less, while Volibear can give you another rune when you play a unit with 5 or more Might. From the middle turns you land Dragons like Direwing, a 7 Might unit that can attack the turn it arrives if you already have a Dragon, and Gentle Gemdragon, an 8 Might unit that readies 2 of your runes whenever you play a Dragon, then take and hold battlefields with units too big to fight.
builds.whyYou: You like a game that builds toward something big. You're happy to spend the first few turns gaining runes instead of attacking, because by turn four or five you're putting down Dragons your opponent's units can't beat in a fight. The deck runs three copies of almost every card, so most games go the way you expect, and your job is picking the right battlefield for each huge unit. If winning by being bigger than everyone else sounds fun, this Volibear suits you.
builds.ratingNotes:
Change 2026-09-25. Relabelled Control to Midrange. Coordinates move from 2/2.5/5/8 to 2.5/4/5/4.5: Variance -3.5, Stance +1.5, Pace +0.5. deckListUrl moves from the bare /decks page to Zach_M's Dragon Voli set 4. The old numbers came from reading guides (riftbound.gg, riftstorm.gg, cardsrealm) that describe a generic ramp plan with no deck behind it. The new ones are the mean of three scored decks from the picked Dragons style. The old guide URLs were not re-read against this list, so they are left out, and guideUrls now point to the three scored deck pages.
Scored decks (pace/stance/complexity/variance; tools.ts style: Midrange 2.5/4/5/4.5, labels Midrange, Midrange, Midrange):
- https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/8f47e3fc-8569-4989-9d36-1bfe4e5fbb4c Dragon Voli set 4 (Zach_M), 2.5/4/4.5/4.5, Midrange
- https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/09b6bfc3-55d5-4970-94fc-5bcd095ba965 Skirmish Voli (mollemecka), 2.5/4/5/5, Midrange
- https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/1dff4ac3-4ea4-42c8-a8cb-ff6b97447752 No Aurora Dragon Volibear (lotuz), 2.5/4/5/4.5, Midrange
Adjustments: none on any sheet.
Cards that decided each Axis:
- Pace: only 3 cheap units per 40 (Dragonsoul Sage and a couple of 2-drops) against 22 to 25 cards costing 5+ (Direwing, Gentle Gemdragon, Kadregrin the Infernal, Elder Dragon, Dune Drake, Volibear, Furious, Rengar, Trophy Hunter).
- Stance: about 6 pressure cards (Dune Drake, Blazing Scorcher) against 8 to 9 answers (Sky Splitter, Challenge, Falling Star, Stormbringer, Sabotage, Repulse) and 25 to 26 own-plan cards (9 ramp plus the Dragon finishers).
- Complexity: 7 to 9 setup cards (Direwing's enter-ready condition, Kadregrin, Show of Strength, Stormbringer), 4 to 7 reactive cards, 9 ramp.
- Variance: no luck or swing cards, 68 to 90 percent of each list run as 3-ofs. 9 ramp cards pull it up and the removal pulls it down.
Formula against judgment: Stance on Zach_M's list is 3 against a judged 5. The formula counts the 7+ Might Dragons as own-plan finishers rather than attackers, so it underrates how hard these decks press the board once they land. Tags stand. The other gaps are below 2.
Legend ability: when you play a Mighty unit (5+ Might), you may exhaust Volibear to channel 1 rune exhausted. It was not given a Complexity or Pace adjustment on any sheet. The reviewer may want to check that.
Also played: Dazzling Aurora Volibear, a ramp-into-Dazzling Aurora Control list (style mean about 1/3/5/6): https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/2f70a6db-647c-4239-ab7e-7bff1a1beff8 (Sultan), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/254b5e4d-3a79-4bdd-ab77-48503f9a7b9d (Alessandro Tassini), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/c12b05db-b306-47e0-82e5-0d1657f33ef7 (ghostnapp). Its only results are the Hartford and Utrecht RQ Best of Volibear lists, now illegal (Aspirant's Climb, banned 2026-07-24). No Axis is 2 apart from Dragons, so it folds in here.
Confidence: high.
Reviewer check: all three scored lists are pre-ban (weighted x0.75). caliburnus's post-ban Volibear Dragons (VEN) guide list (770c1902) could replace the display if Zach_M's list goes stale after the LA RQ. The lead agent recorded the decision to keep Aurora as a discovery deck, reading the recent 'No Aurora' deck titles as players moving off it. The Maintainer should confirm that reading.
